variant.title: Fortress Sudoku
variant.description: Every shaded cell is greater than each orthogonally adjacent unshaded cell.
rule.fortress: Every shaded cell is greater than each orthogonally adjacent unshaded cell.
rule_guide.title: Fortress Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Every shaded cell is greater than each unshaded cell directly above, below, left or right of it.
rule_guide.item_2: For example, a shaded 6 may touch an unshaded 4, but it cannot touch an unshaded 7.
rule_guide.item_3: Two adjacent cells with the same shading have no extra Fortress relationship.
